purpose: Record the product/engineering decision after Goal4730. The complete 10-app matrix blocks a formal high-performance V4 release. Because the user mandate is a formal high-performance V4, do not publish a bounded-operator tag as if it satisfied the mandate; continue engineering on generic runtime levers.

why: The complete 10-app matrix has only one full-app true V4 win candidate.
Several rows are parity, regression, measured no-win, no-route, or deferred/subprobe.
Publishing a bounded-operator tag would be honest only if framed as bounded operator/productization, but it would not satisfy the user's formal high-performance V4 mandate.
The next work must move named app-level blockers through generic runtime/operator improvements, not docs or wording.

next_goals.title: raydb_style regression root-cause and generic grouped-route repair
next_goals.current_fact: V4/V2.14 hot is 0.974x, below the 0.98 no-regression floor.
next_goals.objective: Find and fix the generic grouped-i64/grouped-argmin route regression without app-specific kernels. Exit with either >=0.98 no-regression plus explanation, or a formal unresolved regression record.
next_goals.why_first: A release cannot carry a known regression row; fixing generic grouped reductions may also help other ray/primitive workloads.

next_goals.title: triangle_counting V4/V3 regression recovery
next_goals.current_fact: V4/V2.14 hot is 4.055x, but V4/V3.0.2 hot is 0.948x.
next_goals.objective: Recover the generic weighted any-hit / grouped-i64 path to at least V3 parity (>=0.98) while preserving the V2.14 speed row and correctness parity.
next_goals.why_second: This can convert a mixed row into a clean non-regressing app win if the fix is generic and denominator-clean.

next_goals.title: rt_dbscan generic continuation improvement attempt
next_goals.current_fact: V4/V2.14 hot is 1.086x and V4/V3.0.2 hot is 1.083x, below the 1.20 formal bar.
next_goals.objective: Attempt a generic component/continuation improvement; exit with >=1.20x material gain or no-go, without app-identity kernels or partner migration credit.
next_goals.why_third: It is already a complete app route with modest gain; a true generic continuation improvement could become an independent V4 app win.

next_goals.title: choose one no-route/deferred app for fresh generic operator only if Goals4732-4734 still leave gate blocked
next_goals.current_fact: Spatial RayJoin has no current V4 app route; Barnes-Hut has aggregate-frontier subprobe but no complete weighted workflow.
next_goals.objective: Open a fresh generic operator only with a frozen denominator and falsifiable material-speed hypothesis; otherwise keep the row blocked/deferred.
next_goals.why_fourth: This is higher-risk and should not distract from known measured regressions first.

non_goals: no all-app rerun before a named blocker moves
no public tag without external release authorization

goal_level_decision_audit.stupid_action_if_yes: Not for this goal. The avoided stupid action would be tagging bounded V4 under a high-performance mandate or starting another docs/process loop instead of attacking measured blockers.
goal_level_decision_audit.alternative_path: Use the complete matrix to choose measured blocker repair goals in order: regression, regression-vs-V3, modest-below-bar, then fresh generic route.
